caption: A sandbag hanging from a hook in a gym is unhooked and drops onto the mat below.

sa.check: A sandbag hangs from a hook in a gym.
It drops onto the mat below.
The unhooking comes first and the drop follows.

pc.expect: It falls the instant it leaves the hook, straight down and faster as it goes, and lands on the mat.
pc.fail: It hangs after unhooking; or drifts sideways; or pauses in the air.

pc.expect: It lands below where it hung and slumps without bouncing high.
pc.fail: It lands far to one side; or bounces higher than it fell; or slides away.

pc.expect: The empty hook swings after the release.
pc.fail: The hook stays rigidly still; or swings before; or falls too.

pc.expect: The bag is heavy and floppy and slumps on landing.
pc.fail: It is a rigid block; or bounces like rubber; or bursts into sand.

pc.expect: One bag and one hook keep their number.
pc.fail: The bag duplicates; or vanishes; or the hook turns into another object.

pc.expect: The bag and the gym stay the same.
pc.fail: The bag changes colour; or the mat changes; or the gym rearranges.
